scenario_text: A diffusion-limited association between two binding partners is characterized by measuring the effective bimolecular association rate as a function of solution viscosity. As viscosity increases, molecular encounter slows and the association rate decreases following a power-scaling behavior. The rate is measured across a viscosity sweep. The task is to recover how association rate depends on viscosity.
